title: MOSS Image · Style
blurb: A look: an art style, a palette, a way of drawing. Apply it to anything with the trigger word.
notes: Draft, not trained yet: two MOSS style LoRAs (ai-toolkit, rank 32, attention and MLPs) cut to block ranges and rendered on fixed seeds kept nothing of their style in blocks 34-41 (0-2% of the full change), where a character's likeness lives, so those blocks stay the base's.
optim: the character LoRAs' (at 1e-4 every MOSS LoRA we trained trailed); Automagic v3 stalls on MOSS without a floor under its rate.
